top_fixes.rule: Customer-proposed amount: from the floor up to the full overdue amount (both included) accept; above the full amount record the full amount and say so; below the floor say the smallest recordable amount is the floor and propose it once, and if not accepted treat as a flat refusal (rule 31).
top_fixes.why: floor_min_fmt is the unrounded floor (e.g. 93.24), so the agent accepts amounts below the stated floor of 94 and records a promise where it should propose the floor or treat the answer as a refusal. That gives the wrong amount and the wrong close_call outcome.
top_fixes.fix: negotiate.task_message item 3 (Amount) and the ACCOUNT facts line: change 'Accept any amount from {{floor_min_fmt}} up to {{past_due_fmt}}' to 'Accept any amount from {{floor_fmt}} up to {{past_due_fmt}}, both included. Above {{past_due_fmt}}: record {{past_due_fmt}} and say so. Below {{floor_fmt}}: say the smallest amount you can record is {{floor_fmt}} and propose it once. If they do not accept, treat it as a flat refusal.' If the promise tool checks the amount in pre_process_code, compare against the same rounded floor value.

top_fixes.rule: If the customer says the full amount is too much, propose the floor once and say the remainder stays overdue and the account stays in arrears until cleared. Declining the floor is a flat refusal (rule 31). The floor may be named a second time only as attempt 2 (rule 31).
top_fixes.why: Attempt 1 names the floor again after it was already proposed in item 4. The floor gets offered more often than the brief allows, which breaks the order of offers and the refusal flow (rule 31).
top_fixes.fix: negotiate.task_message item 5: change the Attempt 1 line to '- Attempt 1: propose paying the full amount {{past_due_fmt}} on {{attempt1_text}}. Do NOT name the floor again in attempt 1. The floor may be named a second time only as attempt 2.' In item 4, add: 'When you propose {{floor_fmt}}, say the remainder stays overdue and the account stays in arrears until cleared. If they decline the floor, that is a flat refusal (go to the attempt 2 / refusal path).'

top_fixes.rule: Request for a person: do not ask whether you can help first; call `transfer_to_agent` queue `general` and close `transferred` / `agent_request`. Applies before and after the security check.
top_fixes.why: A request for a person made in the hardship or plan_offer nodes has no transfer tool or route, so the call does not close as transferred / agent_request with queue general.
top_fixes.fix: hardship and plan_offer nodes: add the transfer_general tool (transfer_to_agent with queue baked to 'general', description 'CALL at once whenever the customer asks for a person, a human or an agent; do not ask whether you can help first'). Add a transition 'transfer_to_agent_success_count greater_than 0 -> fin_agent_request', placed before the other transitions.

top_fixes.rule: Request for a new payment plan, lower instalments or spreading over months: do not describe or invent any plan; say the plan review team handles these and ask whether to connect now. Yes -> `transfer_to_agent` queue `restructuring`, close `transferred` / `plan_review`; no -> close `no_promise` / `declined_offer`.
top_fixes.why: A request for a new plan, lower instalments or spreading the payments, made in the hardship node, is not routed to the plan review offer. The agent may then describe a plan or end the call with the wrong outcome instead of transferred/plan_review or no_promise/declined_offer.
top_fixes.fix: hardship node extraction_schema: add the enum value 'new_plan' to the topic field (described as 'customer asks for a new payment plan, lower instalments or spreading over months'). Add the transition 'topic equals new_plan -> plan_offer'. In hardship.task_message, add: 'Never describe or invent a payment plan.'

top_fixes.rule: Before `close_call`, thank the customer for their time and say goodbye, naming Nordvik Savings Bank.
top_fixes.why: The estate farewell does not thank the customer for their time, so the mandatory closing sentence is missed in deceased/estate cases.
top_fixes.fix: end_estate terminal spoken_message: change it to 'Please accept my condolences. Thank you for your time. Goodbye from Nordvik Savings Bank.' Check that every other end_* spoken_message also contains 'Thank you for your time' and 'Nordvik Savings Bank'.
